mutants.name: short-circuit-rhs

mutants.name: negative-shift-ok

mutants.name: oracle-o1-callee-loses-caps

mutants.name: oracle-o22-slice-allocates
mutants.rule: A substring is a view of its text: it allocates no value bytes.

mutants.name: oracle-o23-default-port
mutants.rule: A network policy's origin drops its scheme's default port (std http, NewNet).

mutants.name: oracle-o23-host-case
mutants.rule: A network policy compares a host name in lower case.

mutants.name: oracle-o23-refused-allowed
mutants.rule: A fetch whose origin the policy does not list fails OriginRefused before any exchange.

mutants.name: oracle-o23-limits
mutants.rule: Every limit of http.Limits must be positive: zero is InvalidLimits.

mutants.name: oracle-o23-listen-text
mutants.rule: ListenFailed's Reason is Go's net.Listen error text.

mutants.name: oracle-o23-preflight-codec
mutants.from: case check.CallLen, check.CallConversion, check.CallEmbed, check.CallEncode, check.CallDecode:
mutants.rule: An obligation that reaches encode or decode runs (Never silently skipped: the preflight skips only what the run cannot evaluate).

mutants.name: oracle-o23-preflight-go-extern
mutants.to: if !fn.Pkg.Host() && nativeOf(fn) != nil || false && goNativeOf(fn) != nil {
mutants.rule: An obligation that calls a program extern the evaluator runs (nativesgo.go) is not skipped.

mutants.name: oracle-o24-seeded-file-empty
mutants.from: h.files[p] = &hostFile{dir: f.Dir, data: f.Data, perm: f.Perm}
mutants.rule: A case's setup.sh tree seeds the simulated file system with its files' bytes.

mutants.name: oracle-o25-csv-reason-is-message
mutants.rule: csv's ParseError Reason is the text of Go's Err, Message Go's whole text (runtime/v1 CSVParseError).

mutants.name: oracle-o26-request-body-dropped
mutants.rule: The handler reads the body the client sent, as Go's server read it.

mutants.name: oracle-o26-response-header-dropped
mutants.rule: The handler's response header fields reach the client through Go's server.

mutants.name: oracle-o27-toml-dotted-reopens-header
mutants.rule: A dotted key may not extend a table a [header] defined (TOML 1.0, Table).

mutants.name: oracle-o27-toml-multiline-quotes-lost
mutants.rule: Up to two quotes before a multi-line string's closing three belong to the string.

mutants.name: oracle-o27-toml-offset-unchecked
mutants.rule: A UTC offset's hours are at most 23 and its minutes at most 59.

mutants.name: oracle-o20-go-float-is-exp
mutants.rule: A float extern runs its own Go function (std math's, a program's extern go math.Log).
